newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.30 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.30 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.30 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.

This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.80769 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.29 percent at the previous tender on August 13. Bids for the HK$800 million issue rose to HK$3.64 billion from HK$2.81 billion.

The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 5.14 percent, compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.55288 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.14 percent at the previous tender on August 20.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue was HK$4.68 billion vs HK$4.67 billion. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6936
